Title: Forsaken Station
Description:
After a long long time, Forsaken Station finally has been finished, with over 400 screens, you can enjoy this region that took me 2 years or more in development. There is also other people that help me to make this region possible

- M4rbleL1ne: For helping with all the code within the region, without their help, it couldn't what it is now.
- Mayhemmm: For helping with the code and fixing
- 4slugcats: For doing an amazing region art for the mod
- Roasted&Toasted: For doing all threat themes and 1 song
- Serpanoy: For doing an incredible song
- Millisec: For doing another moody song
- Alekus: For giving a cool long song
- Snoodle: For doing an outstanding echo song and also helping writing the pearls
- Aprilistheworstmonth: For doing cool sky and mountain backgrounds
- Merfaruk: For doing the background of the wall
- Nautillo: For helping doing the palettes for the region
- Alduris: For doing the arenas for the region
- qt_pi: For doing the cornifer map
- Klumquart: For making a harrowing sound
- StarrySpelunker || MLA: For making an excellent region art for the region in the saint timeline

- And all the people that playtested and followed closely the development of my region.

Now, what can you expect for this region?

- Connects to Subterranean, Industrial Complex
- Custom creatures
- Data pearls
- Echo
- Rivulet Timeline changes
- Arenas
- Safari
- Now the region counts with a Saint version! Feel free to explore and find how the times has treated the station.

There is some gates that leads nowhere, this because connects to other custom regions, so when those get released, then you can look for going through those 

Also there will be added more custom creatures hopefully, aswell more sound tracks throughout the region that will be updated

It is recommended to use the 64 bit mod, this because the sheer size of the region may cause memory leaks in the game more often.

Enjoy my region and try to not get lost
RequirementNames: RegionKit,Custom Regions Support,The M4rblelous Entity Pack
